title: BST Search
question: How do you search for a value in a BST in Java? What is the time complexity?
searchIntent: binary search tree search time complexity java
realWorldScenario: O(log n) average for balanced BST; O(n) worst case for skewed tree.

title: BST Insert
question: How do you insert a value into a BST while maintaining the BST property?
realWorldScenario: Insert reaches a leaf position following BST property — create new node there. O(log n) average.

title: BST Delete — 3 Cases
question: How do you delete a node from a BST? Explain all three cases.
searchIntent: delete node BST three cases java
realWorldScenario: Case 1: leaf node (remove directly). Case 2: one child (replace with child). Case 3: two children (replace with inorder successor).

title: Find Min and Max in BST
question: How do you find the minimum and maximum values in a BST?
searchIntent: find minimum maximum BST java interview
realWorldScenario: Min: go to leftmost leaf. Max: go to rightmost leaf. O(log n) in balanced BST.

title: Validate BST
question: How do you validate that a binary tree is a valid BST in Java?
realWorldScenario: Pass min/max bounds recursively — node value must be in (min, max); left inherits max=node, right inherits min=node.

title: Kth Smallest in BST
question: How do you find the Kth smallest element in a BST?
realWorldScenario: Inorder traversal produces sorted order — the Kth element visited is the Kth smallest. Stop early with a counter.

title: BST vs Balanced BST
question: What happens to BST performance when it becomes unbalanced? How do self-balancing BSTs fix this?
realWorldScenario: Inserting sorted data into a plain BST degenerates it to a linked list (O(n) search). TreeMap uses Red-Black tree to stay O(log n).
